_about: Public-domain Samuel McChord Crothers (1857-1927), Unitarian minister of the First Parish, Cambridge, for the Word Hoard: Members of One Body, Fortnightly Sermons, The Understanding Heart, Love that Casteth out Fear, and The Endless Life (the Ingersoll lecture). His literary essays are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 103 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

crothers-members-one-body: Members of one body : six sermons (Boston : G.H. Ellis, 1892)
crothers-understanding-heart: The understanding heart (Boston, American Unitarian Association, 1903)
crothers-love-casteth: Love that casteth out fear (Cambridge : Caustic-Claflin Co., 1904)

_excluded.crothers-literary: The Gentle Reader, The Pardoner's Wallet, Miss Muffet's Christmas Party (literary essays and a children's book)
